verdicts.matching_evidence: In Section 3.2, the text describes the six synthetic 2D datasets (A1, A2, S1, S2, R15, and Aggregation) as "originally designed for evaluating graph neural networks [9]." This is factually incorrect. These datasets are well-known 2D spatial point clouds designed specifically for geometric clustering algorithms like K-means (as the title of citation [9] explicitly notes). Graph neural networks operate on graph structures, not Euclidean point clouds.
